annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that if duplicate Content-Length header fields with identical decimal values are received, the recipient must either reject the message or replace the duplicates with a single valid Content-Length header before determining the message body length or forwarding the message. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
